newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland sold all Kemira shares offered.
newsitem.headline: Finland sold all Kemira shares offered.

text.p: Finland has sold all six million shares in chemicals and fertiliser group Kemira Oy that it offered to private investors, the ministry of trade and industry said in a statement on Thursday.
"The offering that started yesterday continued lively also today and all six million shares offered to the public have been sold," the ministry said.

The state's offering to private investors was priced at 49.50 markka on Tuesday at the end of an offering of 17 million shares to institutional investors -- five million new shares and 12 million of the state's stock.
Private investors get one bonus share for each 10 they buy if they keep them for 12 months.
The total amount offered will rise to 19 million shares, and the lead managers also have an option to increase the issue of new shares by three million, which would raise it to 21 million shares.

If that option were exercised and all shares sold, the state's stake in Kemira would fall to slightly above 54 percent, a trade and industry ministry official said on Wednesday. Before the issue it was over 70 percent
Kemira ended official hours at 50.80 markka, up 0.50.
